lines.l: In the morning when it's time to leave
Take the bird that I cut from your sleeve
Just a token of my unease
Something spoken in my sleep
Unfold me carefully
I'm just a letter you had
No right to read
Can shame be an invitation
History's broken for a bell jar convenience
Too afraid to have an opinion
Chasing tales of fame
Reflections as witness
Holy hands paint the sky anew
Now we dance among the morning dew
Let the berry stain our hearts
In the way that sorrow
Stays too long
Unfold me carefully
I'm just a letter you had
No right to lead
